plugins.name: Plain-words writing
plugins.author: Enplace
plugins.summary: Skills for writing that people read once and act on: updates, release notes and replies.

skills.name: plain-update
skills.description: Write a status update someone can read in ten seconds.
skills.applies: writing an update, a report or a summary

skills.name: release-notes-plain
skills.description: Turn a list of changes into notes people who use the product care about.
skills.applies: writing release notes or What's new

skills.name: reply-to-feedback
skills.description: Answer a review, an email or a bug report kindly and briefly.
skills.applies: replying to a customer, a reviewer or a tester

plugins.name: Ship an app
plugins.author: Enplace
plugins.summary: Skills for getting an iPhone or Android app out: TestFlight builds, store screenshots and review notes.

skills.name: testflight-build
skills.description: Get a build to testers: version, build number, notes and who to send it to.
skills.applies: work on an app release or a beta

skills.name: store-screenshots
skills.description: Plan the store screenshots: which screens, in what order, with what captions.
skills.applies: work on store listing or screenshots

skills.name: app-review-notes
skills.description: Write the notes and demo account details app reviewers need.
